Title: Question of Something that has come up in JOL game

Messages.Author: TigersClaw
Messages.Body:
Card Title: Rotschreck
Pool: n/a
Clan/Discip.: n/a
Card Type: Master
Card Text: Master: out-of-turn
Play when a minion attempts to use aggravated
damaged against a vampire, whether successfully
or not. Combat ends before damage is resolved.
That vampire is put in torpor, tapped, with this card
on it. During the vampire's next untap phase, burn
this card instead of untapping the vampire.
Artist: John Bridges
Rarity: Uncommon 4

Rotschreck:
Play as written.
#
# That is, play on a vampire who is to receive aggravated damage from
# his opponent in combat.

Ok, i understand, but I am not receiving aggravated damage if I dodge. I am
first to declare attack also. Does card still work? It was played after I
declared my strike also.

TigersClaw

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes, it still works. You are the target of the agg strike, so
you are the one "receiving the damage". That phrase is merely
used by way of explaining which minion (the dealer or the
recipient) is targetted by Rotschreck. The actual card text
doesn't mention "receiver", simply "against a vampire". If
you are a vampire and your opponent attempts to use agg damage
against you, then you are a prospect for Rotschreck.

The "whether successfully or not" clause on card text is meant
to answer questions regarding Dodge and damage prevention, etc.

Messages.Author: Stefan
Messages.Body:
1: Can I play amaranth after I just played the kiss of Ra?
I'm not sure because I only have the jyhad version where it says that
if an opposing vampire goes to torpor you get the opportunity to
diablerize. But it doesn't state that it has to be done in combat.

2: If I play movement of the slow body and someone tries to block this
can I play day operation. I think yes.
Also if this vampire had a fame on him would my prey lose another
three pool.
I think no but on the day operation it states that the acting minion
goes to torpor after the action is concluded, only the acting minion
is already in torpor.

3: Exactly when is the blood for an action paid.

if I play an action card that costs 4 blood and my vampire only has 4
blood can I still play action modifiers that cost blood if I don't want
my vampire to be blocked.

Suppose that this vampire is blocked. So he doesn't have to pay
the blood and goes to combat. In this combat he plays terror
frenzy which costs him one blood and as strike he plays form of
mist at superior. What happens to the action.

4: When I try to rescue a vampire without blood from torpor with a
vampire with 2 blood on him can I play earth control to avoid being
blocked and am I therefore unable to rescue the vampire from
torpor.Correct?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <7ke2mv$q8r$1...@news0.skynet.be>,

"Stefan" <stefan.m...@skynet.be> wrote:
>
>
> 1: Can I play amaranth after I just played the kiss of Ra?

No.

> I'm not sure because I only have the jyhad version where
> it says that if an opposing vampire goes to torpor you get
> the opportunity to diablerize. But it doesn't state that
> it has to be done in combat.

It is a combat card, which is a way of stating that it has to
be done in combat.

>
> 2: If I play movement of the slow body and someone tries
> to block this can I play day operation. I think yes.

Yes.

> Also if this vampire had a fame on him would my prey
> lose another three pool. I think no but on the day
> operation it states that the acting minion goes to
> torpor after the action is concluded, only the acting
> minion is already in torpor.

*You* do not lose another three pool, no. (Fame has errata
saying that the controller, not the prey, loses three pool
when the vampire goes to torpor.)

> 3: Exactly when is the blood for an action paid.

When the action remains unblocked. [6.2.3.]

> if I play an action card that costs 4 blood and my
> vampire only has 4 blood can I still play action modifiers
> that cost blood if I don't want my vampire to be blocked.

Yes. The action will "fizzle" (resolve with no effect) if
the cast cannot be paid at the appropriate time.

> Suppose that this vampire is blocked. So he doesn't have to pay
> the blood and goes to combat. In this combat he plays terror
> frenzy which costs him one blood and as strike he plays form of
> mist at superior. What happens to the action.

If no one re-blocks the misty vampire, the action fizzles.

> 4: When I try to rescue a vampire without blood from torpor
> with a vampire with 2 blood on him can I play earth control
> to avoid being blocked and am I therefore unable to rescue
> the vampire from torpor.Correct?

The rescue action fizzles, correct.

Messages.Author: mbohlman
Messages.Body:
On Fri, 18 Jun 1999 20:18:28 +0200 "Stefan"
<stefan.m...@skynet.be> wrote:

> 1: Can I play amaranth after I just played the kiss of Ra?

> I'm not sure because I only have the jyhad version where it
> says that if an opposing vampire goes to torpor you get the
> opportunity to diablerize. But it doesn't state that it has
> to be done in combat.

Actually, it does: it's a combat card. So, no, you can't
use it outside of combat on something like Kiss of Ra.

> 2: If I play movement of the slow body and someone tries to block
> this can I play day operation. I think yes.

Yes, you can, but you'll be right back in torpor obviously.

> Also if this vampire had a fame on him would my prey lose another
> three pool. I think no but on the day operation it states that the
> acting minion goes to torpor after the action is concluded, only the
> acting minion is already in torpor.

Fame affects the controller of the vampire rather than the
prey of the vampire's controller (errata).

In any case, Fame would be triggered because you successfully
left torpor but then are sent to torpor because of Day Operation's
effect.

> 3: Exactly when is the blood for an action paid.

> if I play an action card that costs 4 blood and my vampire only has
> 4 blood can I still play action modifiers that cost blood if I don't
> want my vampire to be blocked.

You don't pay action card costs unless the action is successful.
You pay action _modifier_ card costs immediately. If you no
longer have enough blood to pay for the action card after playing
action modifiers or other things, the action fizzles (has no effect).

> 4: When I try to rescue a vampire without blood from torpor with a
> vampire with 2 blood on him can I play earth control to avoid being
> blocked and am I therefore unable to rescue the vampire from
> torpor.Correct?

You could play Earth Control, but because you can no longer pay
the cost to rescue, the vampire stays in torpor. So yes, you
are correct.

Mike
